correctness.rationale: All six exact finite triangulations were rebuilt from actual Git verify.py facet lists, not asserted logs. Independently checked every edge degree=2, every vertex link seven-cycle and the face vector (12,42,28), so each is a closed Euler-characteristic -2 surface. Independent GF(2) Gaussian elimination gave ranks ∂1=11, ∂2=27 and dim H1=42-11-27=4 in every case. Enumerating all 220 vertex triples yields 48,52,52,52,46,46 graph triangles; subtracting 28 faces gives 20,24,24,24,18,18 empty triangles. Every empty triangular edge chain was checked outside im ∂2, every facial boundary inside it; modding pairwise XOR by this exact image gives multisets [4,4,4,4,2,2], [4,4,4,4,4,4] (three times), [4,4,2,2,2,2,1,1], [4,4,4,1,1,1,1,1,1]. There are no nontrivial simple cycles of <3 edges. On an orientable surface essential F2 class of an embedded triangle is equivalent to nonseparating. This is exhaustive for the six stated complexes, not a universal claim for other genus-two triangulations.

value.rationale: PASS. A complete family-level minimum essential cycle classification of the six natural equivelar genus-two maps is mathematically motivated by combinatorial systolic geometry. The nonseparating criterion and nonuniform homology-class multiplicity distinguish maps with identical local face-vector/degree data; these unknown exact invariants could be used in combinatorial-map classification.

limitations: Only exact six labeled 12-vertex, degree-seven, orientable genus-two maps and simple length-three mod-two 1-cycles; no claim for integral classes, geometric geodesics, longer cycles, or other triangulations.
